correspondences.notes: Only FA has a BIDS suffix (dwi FA); MD, RD, AD and DKI maps and GFA have none in 1.11.2.

brainlife.desc: Diffusion tensor (and optional kurtosis) scalar maps as NIfTI: FA, MD, RD, AD, with optional shape indices, tensor, DKI maps and colour FA.
brainlife.name: neuro/tensor
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Tract profiles, connectome edge weights and ROI or parcel statistics. Registration to templates or anatomy, and FA-based masks.

**Not for:** Assuming DKI maps are present; they need multi-shell data. Comparing maps from different fitting tools or spaces without checking units and registration.

**BIDS:** dwi/FA (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 42 Apps, output of 15 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.tensor.json

files.desc: Tensor measure / Fractional anisotropy (normalized fraction of anisotropic component)
Kurtosis tensor or map from a DKI fit.
DKI measure / Geodesic Anisotropy (normalized fraction of geodesic component)
RGB color value assigned for each voxel (colored FA)

identifying_risks: NIfTI headers or metadata may carry subject codes or dates
Rare lesions or anomalies can be recognisable in small samples
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed diffusion MRI without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Check headers and metadata for identifiers before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only as a group-averaged template
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states
